description: Phase 8: Hardening. Create custom 403/404/500 error pages with templates, implement sitemap.xml using django.contrib.sitemaps, add robots.txt view, add SEO meta tags to base template (title, description, og: tags), write comprehensive tests for models/forms/services/views/permissions across all apps, and achieve >= 80% test coverage using coverage.py.
steps: 1. Create templates/403.html (Forbidden error page with Bootstrap styling, link to home)
2. Create templates/404.html (Not Found error page with Bootstrap styling, search form, link to home)
3. Create templates/500.html (Server Error page with Bootstrap styling, contact link, no template tags for safety)
4. Update config/urls.py to set handler403, handler404, handler500 pointing to custom views in core/views.py
5. Create custom error views in core/views.py: custom_403_view, custom_404_view, custom_500_view that render templates with proper context
6. Create core/sitemaps.py with sitemaps for: StaticViewSitemap (home, about, contact, etc.), JobSitemap (active approved jobs), CompanySitemap (verified companies)
7. Update config/urls.py to include django.contrib.sitemaps.views.sitemap with sitemaps dict
8. Create core/views.py robots_txt view returning robots.txt content (User-agent: *, Allow: /, Sitemap: <sitemap_url>)
9. Add URL pattern in core/urls.py: robots.txt
10. Update templates/base.html to include SEO meta tags in head: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card, canonical link. Use context variables or block overrides.
11. Add get_absolute_url methods to Job and Company models if not present

12. Create comprehensive tests in accounts/tests.py: test_models.py (User model, JobSeekerProfile, calculate_completeness), test_forms.py (registration form validation, login form), test_views.py (register, login, logout, email verification, profile update, resume download permissions), test_permissions.py (role-based access)

13. Create tests in companies/tests.py: test_models.py (Company model, slug generation, Employee model), test_forms.py (CompanyForm validation), test_views.py (company CRUD, employee CRUD, permissions), test_admin.py (admin actions)

14. Create tests in jobs/tests.py: test_models.py (Job model, Category, Skill, JobReport), test_forms.py (JobForm, JobFilterSet), test_views.py (job CRUD, job list filters, report job), test_search.py (full-text search functionality)

15. Create tests in applications/tests.py: test_models.py (Application, ApplicationStatusHistory, Interview), test_services.py (ApplicationService: create, change_status, withdraw, bulk actions), test_views.py (apply, withdraw, applicant detail, bulk actions, CSV export), test_permissions.py (recruiter access to applicants)

16. Create tests in notifications/tests.py: test_models.py (Notification, JobAlert), test_signals.py (signal triggering on application events), test_services.py (NotificationService), test_views.py (notification list, job alerts CRUD), test_commands.py (send_job_alerts matching logic, expire_jobs)
17. Create tests in dashboard/tests.py: test_views.py (employee dashboard, admin dashboard), test_services.py (AdminDashboardService stats), test_permissions.py (admin-only access)
18. Create tests in core/tests.py: test_views.py (home, error pages, contact form, robots.txt, sitemap), test_services.py (AuditLogService)
19. Run coverage: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage run --source='.' manage.py test
20. Generate coverage report: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage report
21. If coverage < 80%, identify untested code paths and add missing tests
22. Generate coverage HTML report: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m coverage html (creates htmlcov/)
23. Run check: C:\Users\arjun\mahi\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check --deploy
24. Fix any warnings from check --deploy (SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS, ALLOWED_HOSTS, etc. - ensure settings correct for prod)
acceptance_criteria: Custom 403/404/500 error pages rendered with Bootstrap styling and helpful links
sitemap.xml accessible at /sitemap.xml listing home, static pages, active jobs, verified companies
robots.txt accessible at /robots.txt with User-agent: * and Sitemap URL
base.html includes SEO meta tags: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card, canonical
Comprehensive tests written for all apps covering models, forms, services, views, permissions
Test coverage >= 80% as measured by coverage.py
python manage.py check --deploy runs without errors (warnings acceptable if documented)
All migrations consistent and up to date
Tests pass: python manage.py test exits with 0
Coverage HTML report generated in htmlcov/ directory
verification: Fix any errors or critical warnings
Access /sitemap.xml, verify XML contains jobs and companies
Trigger 404 by accessing /nonexistent-page/, verify custom 404 page
If < 80%, check htmlcov/index.html to identify gaps, add tests, re-run coverage
Inspect error pages manually (set DEBUG=False temporarily, trigger 403/404/500)
